items.text: Faster page switches — revisiting a page uses an in-memory cache instead of refetching every bookmark list from the API. Hover or focus a page tab to prefetch its data in the background so the first click often feels instant.

No stagger on navigation — switching pages no longer replays the bookmark enter animation on every row (that could add ~1 s with large libraries). Animations still run on the initial dashboard load when enabled.
Cache stays fresh — bookmark saves, category order changes, extension updates, and config structure sync invalidate or update the cache for affected pages so you do not see stale data.

In-place grid patches — when category structure is unchanged, the dashboard updates bookmark rows and titles in place instead of rebuilding the whole grid. Config settings sync uses this path so toggling icons, shortcuts, or density feels snappier.

Cleaner bookmark rows — the dashboard no longer renders separate pin/note badges, and General no longer exposes those two toggles. Pinned bookmarks still sort at the top of their category; the row chrome just stays quieter.
Render fingerprints — each bookmark row stores a data-render-fp fingerprint after full render so the first incremental refresh skips rows that did not change (no unnecessary DOM rebuild).
Save works again — fixed a regression where clicking Save did nothing (ReferenceError in the persistence module). Settings, bookmarks, finders, categories, and pages persist correctly.
Selective persist — config only writes what changed: a settings-only save sends one /api/settings request instead of re-posting every page of bookmarks, finders, categories, and pages.
Faster save feedback — Saved and the success toast appear as soon as the API calls finish; heavy post-save refresh (e.g. reloading all bookmarks for the tags tab) runs in the background.
Save toasts — every save shows a short Saving… toast that swaps cleanly to Configuration saved (settings) or return to the dashboard (structural changes) via AppNotification.replace().
Add finder keeps the list — + Add finder appends a row to the table instead of clearing it. Fixed refresh() receiving the wrong context so existing finders disappeared until reload.
Reorder & validation — move-finder and field-warning refresh pass the config manager again so duplicate-shortcut hints stay accurate after add/reorder.

Modular config.js (phase 6) — bookmarks orchestration, config render/reset, and settings defaults moved into config-bookmarks-controller.js, config-render.js, config-reset.js, and config-settings-defaults.js; config.js is now ~470 lines.

Playwright coverage — page-cache smoke test, incremental DOM specs (noop patch, settings refresh), config save persistence (settings-only skips bookmark POSTs, toast visible), and add-finder list visibility.
Docs — CHANGELOG, What's new, config help (EN/NL/DE/FR), and MANUAL updated for v2026.06.26; release token 2026.06-dashboard-release-v73.
